portalsFound.observation: Official Lagos State land-administration portal describes property search by address, property number, or parcel ID with GIS maps, but the visible service is account-oriented and no open parcel feature list is documented.
Lagos State Surveyor General portal advertises land-information transactions, without a verified downloadable parcel layer.
Federal Surveyor General describes cadastral and legal surveys for government properties nationwide, not a national open parcel polygon database.
